changes.description: Added, removed and modified objects, sorted by `key` in code point order (D2).

ignored.description:
Objects matched across a UUID or generated-content change, in head object
order (today's order; Design Comparison compares it as a set).

byKind.description: Per-kind change counts; the keys are `CompareObjectDeltaKind` values, in code point order.

byReason.description: Change counts per reason; the keys are `CompareObjectDeltaReason` values, in code point order.

description:
Design Comparison's object diff between two bundles (`prism-kicad compare`
`-o`).
title: Compare object delta a0

bundleKey.description: The side's bundle key, computed from its manifest's revision key and generator id (cli-spec.md §5.1.4).

objects.description: How many objects the side's `board-objects.json` holds, review-only objects included.

nativeObjects.description: Every addressable object of the side, in the side's index object order.

componentObjects.description: Every symbol and footprint of the side, in the side's index object order.

status.description: How the object relates the two sides; never `ignored` here.

uuid.description:
The object's id: its KiCad uuid, or a review-only object's synthetic id
(`BoardObjectsReviewOnlyId`). With `documentPath` it forms `key`.

documentPath.description:
The document's path, project-relative (D1), for example
`mini_obc.kicad_pcb`. With `uuid` it forms `key`.

parentUuid.description: Uuid of the object's parent (a pad's footprint, a pin's symbol, ...). Absent when there is none.

at.description: The object's position `[x, y]` in millimetres, in that order, in the frame today's index uses for its kind. Absent when the kind has no position.

rotation.description: The object's rotation in degrees as written, `0` when the form omits it. Absent when the kind has no rotation.

mirror.description: How a symbol is mirrored. Absent when it is not mirrored.

layer.description: The object's layer as written. Absent when the form has none.

layers.description: A via's `(layers …)` entries, in file order. Absent unless the object has layers.

net.description: The object's net, by name. Absent when it has no net.

refdes.description: The object's reference designator. Absent when it has none or it is empty.

libId.description: The object's library link as written. Absent when it has none.

dnp.description: True when the object is do-not-populate. Absent when the kind has no DNP flag.

inBom.description: False when the object is excluded from the BOM. Absent when the kind has no such flag.

onBoard.description: False when the object is not on the board. Absent when the kind has no such flag.

kiidPaths.description: Every occurrence path of a symbol or sheet, schematic form, sorted in code point order. Absent when the kind has none.

instances.description: A symbol's instances, in file order. Absent when the kind has none.

number.description: A pad's or pin's number as written; may be empty. Absent when the form has none.

text.description: A label's, sheet pin's or footprint text's text as written. Absent when the form has none.

name.description: A zone's, group's or review-only object's name. Absent when the form has none.

reviewFields.description: Review fields, with keys in code point order; the keys are review labels. Absent when the kind has none.

reviewOnly.description: True for a review-only object. Absent for an object with a KiCad uuid.

properties.description:
The object's property-delta list
(`CompareObjectPropertyDeltaA0`), sorted by `name` in code point order,
not the object's own property list. Absent when there is no delta.

base.description: The `base`-side object (`modified` and `removed` only). Absent for `added`.

compare.description: The `head`-side object (`added` and `modified` only). Absent for `removed`.

atBase.description: The base object's position in millimetres, `[x, y]` in that order (`modified` only). Absent when it has none.

reasons.description: The classifier reasons, in the order the classifiers run (`modified` only). Absent for `added` and `removed`.

positionDelta.description: The object's move (`modified` only). Absent when it did not move or has no position.

properties.description:
The object's own `(property …)` fields, in file order: a schematic
symbol's or sheet's properties, or a footprint's fields. Absent when the
kind has none.

CompareNativeObjectA0.description: One object as `native_object` carries it (`ecad-diff.mjs:194-220`), for `componentObjects`, `base` and `compare`.

CompareObjectDeltaStatus.description: How an entry relates the two sides.

CompareObjectDeltaKind.description:
Kind of an object, in today's spelling: the bundle kind
(`BoardObjectsObject`, `BoardObjectsReviewOnlyKind`) with every `-` written
`_`.

KiCadUuid.description:
KiCad object UUID in the canonical form KiCad writes (`KIID::AsString`):
lowercase hexadecimal, 8-4-4-4-12. Copied from the file, never generated
or re-cased.

CompareMmPoint.description:
A point in millimetres, `[x, y]` in that order, as today's index writes it.
No rounding: it is the parsed value.

CompareObjectDeltaMirror.description: How a schematic symbol is mirrored, today's parser spelling.

reference.description: The instance's reference. Absent when it has none or it is empty.

path.description: The occurrence path, schematic form. Absent for a `default_instance` entry.

CompareSymbolInstanceA0.description: One `(path …)` instance of a placed symbol (`ecad-diff.mjs` `instances`).

from.description: The base value: a text, a number, a flag, a list (in the order today's index writes it) or a table (keys are KiCad's setting keys). Absent when the property or field is only in the head side.

to.description: The head value: a text, a number, a flag, a list (in the order today's index writes it) or a table (keys are KiCad's setting keys). Absent when the property or field is only in the base side.

attributesChanged.description: True when a property that is present on both sides only moved or was hidden. Absent for a review-field delta.

fromAttributes.description: The base property's attributes. Absent for a review-field delta, or when the property is only in the head side.

toAttributes.description: The head property's attributes. Absent for a review-field delta, or when the property is only in the base side.

CompareObjectPropertyDeltaA0.description:
One property or review-field delta (`ecad-diff.mjs` `property_deltas` and
`review_field_deltas`). A property delta also carries `attributesChanged` and
`fromAttributes`/`toAttributes`; a review-field delta carries only `name`,
`from` and `to`.

CompareObjectDeltaReason.description:
Why a `modified` change was classified, or why an object is in `ignored`.
The classifier reasons are `CLASSIFIERS` plus `properties-changed` and
`content-changed` (`ecad-diff.mjs:32-46`, `:415-435`).

dx.description: Change in x, rounded to 1e-6 mm.

dy.description: Change in y, rounded to 1e-6 mm.

ComparePositionDeltaA0.description: A moved object's position deltas (`ecad-diff.mjs:322-332`), in millimetres.

CompareObjectDeltaIgnoredReason.description: Why a matched object is only in `ignored` (`ecad-diff.mjs:390-411`).

value.description: The field value as written; may be empty.

at.description: The field's `[x, y]` position in millimetres, in that order. Absent when the form has none.

rotation.description: The field's rotation in degrees as written. Present exactly when the field is at a position.

hide.description: True when the field is hidden. Absent unless the form hides it.

effects.description: The field's text effects. Absent when the form has none.

CompareObjectPropertyA0.description: One `(property "Name" "value" …)` field of a symbol, sheet or footprint, as today's index carries it.

anyOf.description: A number as today's index writes it.
A list of texts, in the order today's index writes them.
A list of numbers, in the order today's index writes them.
One table of settings (for example a teardrop parameter set).
A list of tables, in the order today's index writes them.

BoardObjectsReviewValue.description:
One review-field value, as Design Comparison shows it: the value today's
index writes, unconverted (lengths stay the millimetres the file writes,
flags stay booleans, `Size` stays a `w × h` text). A presentation value,
not a typed fact: typed lengths of this member are the `…Nm` fields. A
value of any other shape is written as its canonical JSON text (field
map).

at.description: The property's `[x, y]` position in millimetres, in that order. Absent when it has none.

rotation.description: The property's rotation in degrees. Absent when it has none.

hide.description: True when the property is hidden; false otherwise.

effects.description: The property's text effects. Absent when it has none.

font.description: The `(font …)`. Absent when the effects have none.

justify.description: The `(justify …)`. Absent when the effects have none.

hide.description: True when the effects carry a bare `hide`. Absent when it is not written.

href.description: The `(href …)` as written. Absent when it is not written.

CompareTextEffectsA0.description: A text's `(effects …)` as the vendored parser reads it.

BoardObjectsReviewTable.description: A flat table of settings; keys are KiCad's setting keys as written, serialized in code point order.

face.description: The `(face …)` font name. Absent when it is not written.

size.description: The `(size …)`. Absent when it is not written.

thickness.description: The `(thickness …)` stroke width in millimetres. Absent when it is not written.

bold.description: True when the font has a bare `bold`. Absent when it is not written.

italic.description: True when the font has a bare `italic`. Absent when it is not written.

line_spacing.description: The `(line_spacing …)` factor as written. Absent when it is not written. Parity exemption: today's key is snake case (`kicad-sexpr-parser.mjs`), which is why the font models live in this file of their own (conventions.md, Field naming: one family per file).

color.description: The `(color …)`. Absent when it is not written.

CompareTextFontA0.description: A text's `(font …)` as the vendored parser reads it.

mirror.description: True when the justify form contains `mirror`.

CompareTextJustifyA0.description: A text's `(justify …)` as today's parser reads it.

BoardObjectsReviewScalar.description: One scalar in a settings table.

a.description: Alpha, 0 to 1; 1 when the form omits it.

CompareColorA0.description: A `(color <r> <g> <b> [<a>])` as today's parser reads it.
